title: Delete a candidate's note
statement: An administrator shall be able to delete a specific note associated with a candidate by providing the candidate's unique identifier and the note's identifier, so that the note is permanently removed from the system.
rationale: This functionality is implemented in the DELETE /candidates/{candidate_id}/note endpoint.
business_value: The candidate's note is successfully deleted and the action is recorded in the audit log.
acceptance_criteria: The candidate's note is removed from the system when a valid candidate ID is provided.
An entry is created in the Actions Audit Log indicating the note deletion, including the text of the note and the user who deleted it.
If there is no note associated with the candidate, a 404 error is returned with the message 'This candidate has no note to delete.'
The note is successfully deleted when the correct identifiers are provided.
An error message is returned if the note does not exist.
The system confirms the deletion with a success message.

title: Deallocate a candidate's question bank
statement: An administrator shall be able to delete a candidate's question bank allocation by supplying the candidate's unique identifier, so that the candidate's question bank is no longer associated with their profile.
rationale: This is supported by the DELETE endpoint which calls the deallocate_candidate_question_bank function, which in turn interacts with the database to remove the allocation.
business_value: The candidate's question bank is no longer associated with their profile.
acceptance_criteria: The candidate's question bank allocation is removed from the database when the request is successful.
An appropriate error message is returned if the candidate ID does not exist.
The system confirms the deletion with a success response.

title: Delete Pending Intake Item
statement: An administrator shall be able to delete a pending item by supplying its unique identifier, so that the item is removed from and its files are purged.
rationale: This is supported by the DELETE /intake/pending/{e_id} endpoint, which calls the intake_discard function to remove the item from the queue.
business_value: the intake item is no longer pending and its files are purged

title: Delete a question bank
statement: An administrator shall be able to delete a question bank by supplying its unique identifier, so that the specified question bank and its associated allocations and responses are permanently removed from the system.
rationale: This is supported by the DELETE /question-banks/{qb_id} endpoint, which calls the delete_question_bank function that performs the deletion in the database.
business_value: The question bank is removed from the system, ensuring it is no longer accessible or usable.
acceptance_criteria: The system shall return a 404 error if the question bank ID does not exist.
The system shall return a 403 error if the user does not have the required permissions to delete the question bank.
The system shall confirm the deletion of the question bank with a success message.
